summary_md: **Chris ([@Chris480096](https://x.com/Chris480096/status/2115791471525654839))** highlights **Concat**, a free, local-first, cross-platform CapCut alternative with a multi-track timeline and 4K60 export that embeds an MCP server so Claude Code can create projects, add captions and effects, and export; the author notes it is still beta ([jub0t/Concat](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat)).
